info.comment: Flat vector food product: civic oat cup. A white paper cup with a navy band, oat-beige circles inside, and a blue spoon standing upright. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray #8A93A0, oat beige #D6C4A3, white, light gray. No text, no logos, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered on pale gray, crisp edges.
